questions.q:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.
(A) fell dead in an instant
(B) stunned the movement
(C) of the busy Bazaar and
(D) silenced the cacophony
(E) suddenly, a ringing blast
(F) out of the bodies, which
questions.solution:
D) EDCBFA
E: "Suddenly, a ringing blast" is the starting point, introducing the event.
D: "Silenced the cacophony" logically follows, indicating the effect of the blast.
C: "Of the busy Bazaar and" specifies where the cacophony is happening, linking with the previous.
B: "Stunned the movement" follows logically, showing how the blast impacted the people in the Bazaar.
F: "Out of the bodies, which" provides additional detail about the aftermath of the blast.
A: "Fell dead in an instant" completes the sentence by describing the final outcome

The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

questions.solution:
B) 'throne'के बदले 'thrown’ का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि ‘throne' एक Noun है और जिसका अर्थ है 'राजसिहासन' जबकि 'thrown' Past Participle रूप हैं Verb ‘throw' का जिसका अर्थ है 'फेंकना' ।

questions.q:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.
(A) her suburbs, she was enthralled to see
(B) one cold evening, when she went
(C) autumn still attached to
(D) the last golden leaf left from
(E) out for a walk on the snowy paths of
(F) an otherwise leafless tree
questions.solution:
C) BEADCF
B ("One cold evening, when she went") starts the sentence by introducing the time and context.
E ("out for a walk on the snowy paths of") logically follows as it describes where she went.
A ("her suburbs, she was enthralled to see") continues the action, connecting her walk with what she observed.
D ("the last golden leaf left from") adds detail to what she saw, introducing the leaf.
C ("autumn still attached to") specifies the connection of the leaf to autumn.
F ("an otherwise leafless tree") concludes the sentence by describing the tree.

questions.q:

A. Lying in bed waiting
B. For the postman to bring
C. Him news of a legacy
D. Luck keeps on
questions.solution:
D) DABC
D: "Luck keeps on" is the starting phrase of the sentence, establishing the subject and verb.
A: "Lying in bed waiting" logically follows as it describes what the subject (luck) is doing.
B: "For the postman to bring" complements the action by indicating what is being awaited.
C: "Him news of a legacy" gives the final detail, completing the sentence with the object.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
Boundaries, junctions, transitions and thresholds are important to us in many different ways, serving not only logistic or ornamental functions, _____1______ possessing important psychological, aesthetic and philosophical implications. An _____2_______representation of a boundary is seen in the vedi, altar of the Vedic yajna, constructed in bricks. Called prastara, it was meant to limit the sacrificial fire, demarcate a ______3_______space and contain _____4_____energy and make the ritual of benefit to the yajamana. Shaped like a vihanga, bird, the border around the vedi becomes the prototype for all borders in the Indian tradition, a border that functions not only to demarcate the sacred from the secular but equally carries with it, metaphysical implications. To enclose the finite is an invitation to experience the infinite, for the human eye cannot _____5______ the infinite.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
D) 'but also' का use होगा क्योंकि "but also" का अर्थ है 'परंतु इसके साथ ही,' जो कि sentence के पिछले भाग को जोड़ता है। sentence में mention है कि सीमाएँ और परिवर्तनों के महत्वपूर्ण मनोवैज्ञानिक, सौंदर्यात्मक और दार्शनिक निहितार्थ भी हैं, इसलिए 'but also' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'however' का अर्थ है 'हालांकि,' 'but' का अर्थ है 'परंतु,' और 'when' का अर्थ है 'जब,' जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं हैं।
'But also' will be used because it means 'but additionally,' which connects and completes the previous part of the sentence. The sentence indicates that boundaries and transitions have significant psychological, aesthetic, and philosophical implications, making 'but also' the correct choice here. On the other hand, 'however' means 'although,' 'but' means 'yet,' and 'when' means 'at the time that,' which do not fit in this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
Boundaries, junctions, transitions and thresholds are important to us in many different ways, serving not only logistic or ornamental functions, _____1______ possessing important psychological, aesthetic and philosophical implications. An _____2_______representation of a boundary is seen in the vedi, altar of the Vedic yajna, constructed in bricks. Called prastara, it was meant to limit the sacrificial fire, demarcate a ______3_______space and contain _____4_____energy and make the ritual of benefit to the yajamana. Shaped like a vihanga, bird, the border around the vedi becomes the prototype for all borders in the Indian tradition, a border that functions not only to demarcate the sacred from the secular but equally carries with it, metaphysical implications. To enclose the finite is an invitation to experience the infinite, for the human eye cannot _____5______ the infinite.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
questions.solution:
A) 'Earliest' का use होगा क्योंकि "earliest" का अर्थ है सबसे प्रारंभिक या प्राचीन, और यहाँ यह एक representation की बात कर रहा है जो सबसे प्राचीन समय की है। 'Earliest' एक adjective है, जो 'representation' को modify कर रहा है, और यहाँ का context प्रारंभिक या सबसे पहले के समय की बात कर रहा है।'Early' का अर्थ भी प्रारंभिक होता है, लेकिन यह superlative नहीं है, इसलिए यह यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं है। 'Establish' एक verb है, जबकि यहाँ हमें adjective की आवश्यकता है, इसलिए यह grammatically incorrect है। 'Slightest' का अर्थ होता है सबसे छोटा या मामूली, जो यहाँ के context में फिट नहीं बैठता।
'Earliest' will be used because it means the most ancient or earliest, and here it refers to a representation from the earliest times. 'Earliest' is an adjective modifying 'representation,' and the context is about something from the earliest period.
'Early' also means initial or early, but it is not a superlative, so it isn't suitable here. 'Establish' is a verb, while an adjective is needed in this context, making it grammatically incorrect. 'Slightest' means the smallest or slightest, which doesn't fit the context here.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
questions.solution:
D) 'Sacred' का उपयोग होगा क्योंकि "sacred" का अर्थ होता है पवित्र, और यह स्थान, वदि, एक धार्मिक अनुष्ठान के लिए पवित्र स्थान था, जहां बलिदान किया जाता था। यह पवित्रता और धार्मिकता को सीमांकित करने के लिए उपयोग किया गया था, इसलिए 'Sacred' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Satisfied' का अर्थ है संतुष्ट होना, 'Unsafe' का अर्थ है असुरक्षित, और 'Scared' का अर्थ है भयभीत होना, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है।
'Sacred' will be used because it means holy or religious, and this place, the vedi, was a sacred space for performing rituals where sacrifices were made. It was meant to demarcate sanctity and religious significance, making 'Sacred' appropriate here. Whereas, 'Satisfied' means content, 'Unsafe' means not safe, and 'Scared' means afraid, which don't fit in this context.

To enclose the finite is an invitation to experience the infinite, for the human eye cannot _____5______ the infinite.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
questions.solution:
A) 'Its' का use होगा क्योंकि "its" का अर्थ है किसी वस्तु या जगह से संबंधित होता है। sentence में mention है कि energy को contain किया जाता है, जो कि altar के लिए है, इसलिए 'its' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'it's' का अर्थ है "it is" या "it has", जो इस context में सही नहीं है। 'there' का अर्थ है "वहां", और 'their' का अर्थ है "उनका", जो इस context में फिट नहीं होते हैं।
'Its' will be used because "its" denotes possession or relation to a thing or place. The sentence states that energy is contained, which refers to the altar, making 'its' the correct choice. Whereas, 'it's' means "it is" or "it has," which does not fit in this context. 'There' means "in that place," and 'their' means "belonging to them," which are not suitable in this context.

To enclose the finite is an invitation to experience the infinite, for the human eye cannot _____5______ the infinite.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
questions.solution:
B) 'Fathom' का use होगा क्योंकि "fathom" का अर्थ होता है किसी चीज़ की गहराई को समझना या मापना। sentence में यह mention है कि मानव आँख अनंत को समझ नहीं सकती, इसलिए 'fathom' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Fatigue' का अर्थ है थकावट, 'Magnify' का अर्थ है बड़ा करना, और 'Percept' का अर्थ है धारणा या समझ, जो इस context में सही नहीं है।
'Fathom' will be used because it means to understand or measure the depth of something. The sentence suggests that the human eye cannot comprehend the infinite, making 'fathom' the appropriate choice here. Whereas, 'Fatigue' means exhaustion, 'Magnify' means to make larger, and 'Percept' refers to perception or understanding, which don't fit in this context.
